profile.headline: Software Engineer at tuutkia
profile.summary: Software developer with experience in developing engaging, scalable full stack applications. A passionate focus on a JavaScript stack with an emphasis on React for the frontend and high availability Node servers on the backend.

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Languages: Javascript (ES6, ES5), SQL, CSS3/HTML5, YAML
• Libraries: JQuery, Underscore, Lodash, Axios, Request, Bluebird
• Front End Frameworks: React, Bootstrap, HTML + CSS
• Back End Frameworks: Node, Express, Passport
• Testing Frameworks: Mocha/Chai, Jest, Enzyme, Jasmine
• Databases: MySQL/Sequelize, PostgreSQL/PG, Knex.js, MongoDB/Mongoose, SQLite, Redis
• Deployment: Heroku, Docker, AWS (ElasticBeanstalk, EC2, RDS, S3), Github Pages
• Load/Stress Testing: Artillery.io, New Relic
• Continuous integration: CircleCI
• Regularly work in conformance with Agile Software and Test Driven Development methodologies

positions.title: Field Tech
positions.description:
• Worked closely with company executives to identify new business opportunities and
     routinely participated in the sales process		
• Managed projects and served as primary liaison between client and multiple internal
     groups to ensure clarity of goals and quality and adherence to deadlines			
• Established long-term customer relationships through prompt and courteous service,              
     that resulted in company referrals to more businesses and sales increase			
• Resolved customer complaints and adjusted orders			
• Verified loads against shipping papers			
• Data Entry, Proofread data, Records and reports

volunteerExperiences.description: My roll in the administration area was to set many patients with appointments, make sure they check in and check out with all of their concerns and questions answered. Relay messages to Drs. and reply to voice mails. At Seton it was a great experience i got to learn hands on and every one in there was super cool.

As and intern i worked under supervision from the VP, this allowed me to work on every type of car from coupes to luxury car like porches, Mercedez, BMW, and highly computerize maintenance car like hybrids i learned so much i feel very confident in working in my own car and others. Im a fast learner i did everything in the mechanic field as basic as oil change to complex as timing belt and engine repair.
